title: Core Layer9 overflow law was temporarily mis-scoped as Game G15 saturation
cause: G15 game-simulation numeric law was applied to core-kernel Fixed128 before the Layer9 core integer precision section was re-read directly from the authoritative DOCX.
violation: Core Layer9 requires overflow immediate FREEZE and explicitly forbids saturating arithmetic; G15 saturation is scoped to authoritative game simulation.
impact: core-kernel/src/engine/fixed128_math.rs temporarily used saturation in commits 9de75b6b.. through 3e4d1dba..
fix: de26aebb8202c1fb2e4cee69655659884a4342f9 restores core overflow FREEZE semantics while retaining valid signed-edge fixes
prevention: For duplicated numeric terminology, resolve nearest enclosing authoritative layer before mutation.
Read both general runtime law and subsystem-specific law before changing shared/core arithmetic.
Evidence files that become invalid must be marked superseded in current HEAD, not merely contradicted in chat.
